items.title: Holding the Helper Candle by a Window
items.alt: A woman in a navy cardigan and mustard skirt holds a lit helper candle above an unlit hanukkiah in a wooden window frame.
items.description: The wooden window frame surrounds a silver candleholder with eight unlit tapers and an empty raised holder. Beside it, a woman holds the lit helper candle clear of her navy cardigan and mustard skirt.

items.title: Three Children Playing Dreidel
items.alt: Three children sit on an oval rug watching a wooden dreidel and gold chocolate coins; the boy in the middle wears glasses and a blue kippah.
items.description: A boy in a mustard hoodie reaches toward a wooden dreidel while two children watch from either side. Their coral, teal and denim clothes form a bright group above the oval woven rug and scattered gelt.

items.title: Grating Potatoes at a Kitchen Table
items.alt: A silver-haired woman in a lilac shirt and blue apron grates a potato into a metal bowl on a wooden worktable.
items.description: The cook steadies a box grater over a round metal bowl while holding a peeled potato against its face. A whole potato and folded blue-striped cloth rest on the shelf beneath the wooden worktop.

items.title: Lifting a Latke from the Skillet
items.alt: A man in a blue kippah and green apron lifts a golden latke onto a plate beside a skillet on a blue kitchen cart.
items.description: A slotted spatula carries one crisp latke from the skillet toward a blue-rimmed plate. The cook stands beside a complete blue kitchen cart with potatoes, bowls, oil and a covered pot stored below.

items.title: Piping Jam into Sufganiyot
items.alt: A woman with a long braid and glasses pipes red jam into a doughnut at a wooden baking table, with a jam jar and tray nearby.
items.description: The pointed piping nozzle meets a doughnut on the wooden worktop as the baker squeezes the bag with both hands. A red jam jar and tray of round doughnuts frame her cream apron and rust-colored top.

items.title: Packing Doughnuts and Gelt into a Gift Box
items.alt: An older man in a blue kippah and knitted vest packs jelly doughnuts and foil chocolate coins into an open box at a round table.
items.description: An open kraft box holds sugar-dusted doughnuts and brightly wrapped chocolate coins. The seated man reaches across the round wooden table, with a blue ribbon spool and patterned bowl of gelt beside him.
